name: Ichikura Suzune
source:
She is the best girl in her grade and wears glasses. She is 153cm tall. 

She is the chairperson of the committee and is serious. She is always rather calm, but sometimes smiles.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/SYG/index.html]official site[/url]]
